messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT - multiple inputs per item
parts:
Would a table panel work? Can't say I like the idea of scrolling too much (also possible with customized item structures, but more clunky).

library(mirtCAT)
df <- data.frame(Question = c(as.character(tabsetPanel(tabPanel("Panel 1", "some text"),
                                                       tabPanel("Panel 2", "some more text"))),
                              'Something',
                              as.character(tags$b("This text is bold."))),
                 Option = options, Type = "radio")
results <- mirtCAT(df = df, shinyGUI = list(forced_choice = FALSE))

Phil
